KnowledgeArticle.Title: Fireworks Complaint
KnowledgeArticle.Description: Report the sale, use, storage, or transport of illegal fireworks.

Section.Name: 911 Fireworks Complaint
Section.Content:
Call 911

Call 911 to report:

  • Illegal fireworks sale in progress
  • People storing large amounts of fireworks
  • Fireworks that are an imminent threat to your personal safety

In New York City, all consumer fireworks, including sparklers, are illegal to use, buy, sell, or transport.

What Happens Next

Officers from your local police precinct will respond when they are not handling emergency situations.

The police may seize vehicles used to transport fireworks.
